evals.prompt: Review this inherited test file for TDD anti-patterns — I don't trust it yet.
evals.expected_output: Agent checks each test for implementation-coupling and tautological assertions, reporting per-test findings with suggested fixes, without rewriting tests unprompted.
Agent identifies the assertion as tautological since it recomputes the expected value the same way the code does, and explains why an independent source of truth is needed instead.
